title: Recording decreases, including to zero, with effective dates and reasons
question: How does a user record a decrease (to any value, including zero), and on which effective date? Must they say whether it is a correction or physical loss? Is deleting an asset ever the same as recording lost work?
context: Decreases are allowed (PROG-REQ-019). Today zero-only edits can be rejected, a missing snapshot can move the effective date to now, and deleting an asset removes its history (PROG-REQ-022, PROG-REQ-023).
